external_python_packages_used_by_openmet.role: HTTP client for OpenMetadata REST calls

no_openmetadata_sdk_installed_reason: The client is a bespoke httpx REST implementation targeting /api/v1/tables and /api/v1/tables/name/{fqn}. pyproject.toml pins no openmetadata-* package. This decouples T2S from OM SDK release cadence and reduces attack surface, at the cost of manual API compatibility.
